response.what_it_is: A multi-piece tool set in a plastic case including an impact drill, multimeter, hand tools, and fasteners.
hidden_risks: Durability and copper winding quality of the generic impact drill motor
Safety compliance and accuracy of the included multimeter
Tensile strength and brittleness of the hand tools and bits
response.best_proof: A close-up photo of the drill's rating plate/specifications and the multimeter powered on.
seller_claims_unsupported: Quality (subjective term for unbranded generic tools)
response.failure_mode: Valuing the item strictly as a standalone drilling machine while ignoring the value and inclusion of the accompanying tool set, or overvaluing generic tools based purely on quantity.
